d: Kendriy mantri jyotiradity sindhiya ne bihar ki rajdhani patna sthit vishv prasiddh bihar sangrahalay (Bihar Museum) ka daura kiya. is dauran bihar sangrahalay ke mahanideshak anjni kumar sinh bhi unke sath maujud rahe aur unhonne sangrahalay ki vibhinn dirghaon va kalakritiyon ke bare men jankari di.
